capabilities: Play a metronome from 30 to 300 BPM with tap tempo and time signatures
Detect pitch with a chromatic tuner showing note, frequency and cents deviation
Adjust the A4 reference pitch from 415 to 466 Hz
Run Open, Start metronome and Stop metronome commands
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README links a Patreon for support and documents that the tuner processes microphone audio entirely on-device without recording or sending it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in audio tools for music practice, so players must switch to a separate metronome or tuner app while working in their vault.
summary: Metronome and chromatic tuner in a side view, letting musicians practise with tempo clicks and pitch readings while their notes stay open.
